fr.elements: Main Building; Secondary Building; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Internal Drive Aisle; Landscaped Area; Walkway; Dumpster Enclosure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Multiple Structures; Dense Vegetation
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the single access point with clearly visible address signage readable from the approaching roadway.

• Post a site map at the access point showing the locations of both buildings, the drive aisle, parking areas, and the dumpster enclosure.

• Mark each building with a distinct identifier (e.g., Building A, Building B) visible from the drive aisle.

• Keep the drive aisle clear of parked vehicles to allow unobstructed movement between both structures.

• Trim vegetation along the drive aisle to maintain clear sightlines from the access point to both buildings.

• Keep the area directly in front of both building entrances clear for emergency vehicle positioning.

• Mark a designated staging area within the parking areas for emergency vehicles responding to either structure.

• Keep the dumpster enclosure gates closed and confirm the enclosure does not block drive aisle access or building approaches.

• Trim dense vegetation away from building faces to maintain visible access points and allow responders to move around both structures.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Landscaped Island; Large Paved Area; Open Paved Area; Multiple Access Routes; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster to reduce the concentration of vegetation near any adjacent buildings or structures.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from the landscaped island closest to the building.
• Keep the landscaped island clear of accumulated leaf litter and dead vegetation at ground level.
• Maintain the open paved areas free of any vegetation encroachment along edges and expansion joints.
